clients.purpose: Advanced from 9a1ebada to re-pin backend schema 6cd52f17 (PR #463: admin-configurable image/file upload size limits — ServerConfig/Channel imageMaxUploadBytes/fileMaxUploadBytes and SignedURL.contentLengthRange, enforced via a signed x-goog-content-length-range header). Frontend PR #730 (head 58b7f8b7) replays that signed header on uploads and re-pins the additive schema; 360-operation contract re-validated against it. Schema and operations are byte-identical to 1ae36cd4; 58b7f8b7 only adds upload-helper unit tests.
